entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Done. The root cause: stubgen's `AliasPrinter` (the `NodeVisitor[str]` used to stringify class bases and alias right-hand sides) had no `visit_star_expr` method, so when a base class like `Generic[*_Ts]` was parsed into an `IndexExpr` containing a `TupleExpr` with a `StarExpr`, the default visitor returned `None`, producing `TypeError: str object expected; got None` while joining tuple items. The fix adds `visit_star_expr` to `AliasPrinter` (returning `"*" + o.expr.accept(self)`) and imports `StarExpr` in `mypy/stubgen.py`. Verified with the issue's repro plus variants (`Generic[T, *_Ts]`, `Generic[Unpack[_Ts]]`, `Generic[*tuple[int, str]]`), and the full `teststubgen.py` suite passes (339 passed).
